name: Naryu's Challenges
intro: So, you're looking to join the Morag Tong, hero? All right, I think I can show you the ropes. I've got ten challenges that'll show you some of my favorite tricks.
outro: My, my. You're a quick study, hero. As far as I'm concerned, we should start giving you writs to carry out. Next time, maybe you can show me a thing or two.

puzzles.name: Orc Clan Shaman
puzzles.description: Show the strength of the clan
puzzles.flavor: This is a technique I picked up from some Orc bandits a while back. In return, I gave them a really merciful death.
solution: Play Bangkorai Butcher and Militant Chieftain in the Shadow Lane.
Attack with all available creatures.
Play Stoneshard Orc in the Field Lane and target the Marked Man.

puzzles.name: Stendarr's Hammer
puzzles.flavor: Brawn isn't everything, but it is something. I trust a big, strong hero like you can handle this one.
solution: Play Morag Tong Assassin.
Play Imprisoned Deathlord in the same lane as the Morag Tong Assassin.
Play Nord Firebrand and Rampaging Minotaur.
Play Stendarr's Hammer on the Imprisoned Deathlord.
Play Mentor's Ring on the Rampaging Minotaur.
Attack the Target with Imprisoned Deathlord.
Attack with all remaining creatures.

puzzles.name: Unstoppable Rage
puzzles.flavor: Are you an angry person? I think everyone is sometimes. The key is to channel that anger.
solution: Play Gavel of the Ordinator on a Tusked Bristleback.
Play Unstoppable Rage on the Tusked Bristleback that does not have the Gavel of the Ordinator.
Play Fire Storm in the Field Lane.
Attack with both creatures.

puzzles.name: Hatchery Meddler
puzzles.flavor: To some, the Morag Tong are killers. To others, we're justice itself. Remember, there are two sides to every story.
solution: Play Hatchery Meddler, targeting the Portcullis.
Play Dark Rebirth on Hatchery Meddler, then target the Flame Atronach in the Field Lane.
Play Imperial Armor on the Flame Atronach in the Field Lane.
Play Dark Rebirth on the Hatchery Meddler, then target the Flame Atronach in the Field Lane.
Attack with the Flame Atronach in the Field Lane.

puzzles.name: Trespasser's Bane
puzzles.flavor: As an assassin, you'll need to sneak past guards almost every day. But some are trickier to sneak past than others.
solution: Play Swindler's Market.
Play Mages Guild Recruit and choose Trespasser's Bane.
Play Giant Bat in the Shadow Lane.
Play Trespasser's Bane on the Giant Bat.
Attack with Giant Bat.

puzzles.name: Trial of Flame
puzzles.flavor: This should be quite the trial -- but you live for that sort of thing, right?
solution: Play Battlerage Orc in the Field Lane.
Play Grappling Hook on the Battlerage Orc, and select Imperial Legionnaire.
Use all 3 Skirmisher's Elixirs on the Imperial Legionnaire.
Play Trial of Flame in the Field Lane.
Play both Wood Orc Headhunters.
Attack with all creatures.

puzzles.name: Green-Touched Spriggan
puzzles.flavor: You're looking a bit under the weather today, hero. Not to worry; this challenge is guaranteed to reinvigorate you.
solution: Play both Ebonheart Oracles in the Field Lane.
Play Snake Tooth Necklace on the House Kinsman.
Attack the Prized Chicken with the House Kinsman.
Play Feasting Hunger in the Field Lane, sacrificing House Kinsman to do so.
Attack with Green-Touched Spriggan.
puzzles.notes: UESP lists Naryu at 60 health, but the documented solution (UESP and the Steam guide agree) deals exactly 48 with two stacking Ebonheart Oracles (x4): Spriggan 1+16+12+16 = 45 power plus House Kinsman's 3. Health set to 48.

puzzles.name: Voice of Balance
puzzles.text: Survive for one turn to win.
puzzles.flavor: A sense of balance is essential in this line of work.
solution: Play Imperial Camp.
Play Septim Guardsman.
Play Close Call on the Septim Guardsman.
Play Septim Guardsman in the Field Lane.
Play Legion Shield on Septim Guardsman.
Play Mace of Encumbrance on Septim Guardsman, shackling an Awakened Imperfect.
Play Prison Ship, shackling another Awakened Imperfect.
Play both Voice of Balance in the Shadow Lane.
Press the button to end your turn.

puzzles.name: Ulfric's Uprising
puzzles.flavor: When I train a new assassin, all I can ever ask is that they rise up to their true potential.
solution: Play Shadowgreen Elder, Ayrenn, and Hlaalu Oathman in the Shadow Lane.
Play Doppelganger in the Shadow Lane, selecting Hlaalu Oathman to copy.
Play Ulfric's Uprising repeatedly, until each Enraged Mudcrab has 20 power.
Attack with all creatures.

puzzles.name: Morag Tong Aspirant
puzzles.flavor: I learned this next technique from one of my most eager students. See if you can follow it.
solution: Play all 3 Bruma Profiteers.
Attack each Mournhold Guardian with the Morag Tong Aspirant in the same lane.
Play Archer's Gambit on a Morag Tong Aspirant (at least one will be a valid target). Target the other Morag Tong Aspirant.
Play Quicksilver Crossbow on a Morag Tong Aspirant, targeting the other one.
Attack with Protector of the Mane.
puzzles.notes: Archer's Gambit uses its original cost of 2 (raised to 3 in Patch 2.11, after this puzzle was made).
